question: Should OpenClaw bundle and permanently own this Twilio-backed RCS channel, or should it ship as an external ClawHub code plugin with only any missing generic plugin API proposed separately?
rationale: VISION.md and the existing native channel-plugin distribution path favor external ownership, while the contributor argues RCS should share the bundled tier of the carrier-adjacent SMS channel; automation cannot choose that long-term product and ownership boundary.

options.title: External ClawHub plugin
options.body: Publish RCS as a code plugin and submit only a narrowly justified generic webhook API enhancement to core if the external implementation truly needs it.

options.title: Sponsor bundled channel
options.body: Accept long-term core ownership of the Twilio RCS configuration, credentials, webhook, delivery, documentation, and upgrade surface after all patch and proof blockers are resolved.

recommendation.title: External ClawHub plugin
recommendation.body: Publish RCS as a code plugin and submit only a narrowly justified generic webhook API enhancement to core if the external implementation truly needs it.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged bundled Twilio SMS implementation is the closest product precedent, and this person introduced that behavior.
